comment: Preserved A86 setup miss. C wizcmds.c:wiz_level_change emits one More page per level, so the single space before the next command was consumed while the hero was still leveling; neither monster-genesis prompt ran. The raw C capture is retained under /tmp/A86-attempts and excluded from recordings/. The corrected recipe uses the observed 29-space dismissal sequence.

segments.moves:
#levelchange
30
 #wizintrinsic
a>>h
 #wizgenesis
hostile Famine
 #wizgenesis
hostile stone golem
